prompts: Create a new variant of reference1 mechanical silver dragon UI background with structural awareness of the ACTUAL main compass circle in reference2. Output ONLY portrait background artwork, not screenshot, no controls, map, gold, words or digits. Keep 853x1844 aspect. Critical geometry: the real map circle at 390px phone width is center (195,285), radius195; in this 853px-wide artwork its center is (426.5,623), radius426.5, top y196.5, bottom y1049.5. Draw a perfectly circular machined silver bearing ring immediately OUTSIDE that exact circle. Not an oval, not a smaller inset circle. Its left/right extremes touch canvas edges; side ring is naturally cropped. All decoration must support and follow this exact aperture, with nothing required INSIDE it because the live map occludes it. Fill interior with dull neutral metal, later masked by game. Design: main circle is the structural heart of an ancient precision instrument. Substantial stepped concentric silver bearing rails, 4 clearly visible diagonal load-bearing brackets at NW/NE/SW/SE (approximately 10:30,1:30,4:30,7:30) sitting outside circle, recessed pivot bolts aligned radially toward its center, fine radial indexing engravings, segmented gear track just outside rim. Upper brackets join upper instrument shelf; lower brackets flow into dragon-scaled structural ribs and lower chassis. A symmetric support arch below circle structurally connects the lower-left sculpted dragon and lower-right joystick housing. Scale rows fan concentrically around the main compass and become segmented metal plates where they meet the rim. No random flourish crossing its geometry. Preserve the ornate engraved dragon-scaled TOP HEADER (no empty gray field), lower-left dragon head, filled scale-work joystick housing already raised as in reference1 (center approx x675 y1190), and bottom inventory seating area. Match reference1 neutral graphite silver hue exactly, same hue as actual grey-silver gadgets in reference2. No beige, bronze, warm champagne or blue steel. Detailed but coherent mechanical relief, subtle lighting upper-left; supports readable at phone size. This is an alternative E, retaining the approved mechanical-scalework vocabulary while making its circle structurally and aesthetically deliberate.

Edit this silver mechanical dragon background preserving style, neutral silver hue and composition. Two necessary corrections. FIRST: enlarge the main circle's clear inside diameter by 10% and move its center upward by 25px on this 853x1844 image. Its INNER rim MUST now touch x0 and x853 at mid-height y623, with inner rim top y196 and bottom y1050. All bearing rails, gear teeth and 4 diagonal mounting brackets move outward to remain OUTSIDE this expanded clear circle, cropped off left/right canvas edges as necessary. The main circle is a real circle, not oval. This lets an actual full-width round map fit within the support structure. Keep substantial NW/NE and SW/SE brackets in the outer corners. SECOND: the lower-right joystick medallion currently has a blank gray circular face; replace the entire blank face with engraved overlapping silver scales continuous with the adjacent scale panel, NO blank gray disk. Move this small housing up 70 pixels so its center is about y1210. Keep the top header entirely scaled, dragon left, lower panel, neutral grayscale silver hues. The large central circle may remain dull metal as it is masked in use. No UI, map, letters, gold or colored elements. Output full portrait artwork.
